description: Synthetic inventory for an event-day live poll that stores only anonymous counts plus a short-lived device nonce to stop double voting.

consent.notice_ref: on-screen notice: answers are anonymous and counted only; hosting provider is in the US

event-plus-90d.description: Counts kept 90 days after the event for the session debrief, then deleted.

event-day-only.description: Deleted at the end of the event day.

stores.description: Running tally per question and option.

fields.name: question_id
fields.purpose: identify which poll question a tally belongs to
fields.deletion_path: tally table dropped by the post-event cleanup step

fields.name: option_counts
fields.purpose: show the room the live result and feed the session debrief
fields.deletion_path: tally table dropped by the post-event cleanup step

stores.description: Short-lived guard against one device voting twice.

fields.name: device_nonce_hash
fields.purpose: stop the same device voting twice on one question
fields.deletion_path: guard table truncated by the end-of-day cleanup step
